title: Product of monomials and symmetric difference
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $S,T$ be subsets of the $n$ coordinate indices, and let $x$ be a vector of $n$ signs. The product of the monomials indexed by $S$ and $T$, evaluated at $x$, equals the monomial indexed by their symmetric difference, evaluated at $x$.
